critical_code_review_comments: complete_alignment_report_pdf.py uses deprecated FPDF2 params (ln=1 and dest='S') — still functional but should migrate to new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT and pdf.output() with no dest arg before FPDF2 removes them in a future version.
Aggregator LANES order is deterministic and mirrored by frontend + PDF renderer — good separation of concerns.
Joint route correctly returns 404 (not 403) for both unknown and unauthorised cases — no existence leak (verified).
ElevenLabs cache key includes provider='elevenlabs' so any residual OpenAI cache entries are naturally invalidated — good migration hygiene.
